text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Swan Stakes drawing near, KS 
Miracle's progress was— in prime 
condition!
choice_data_list: Alright, that completes this set of goals!
Alright, that's the last goal in the set!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew, huff... Yes. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "...Um, so... er, what do you think?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The Swan Stakes... Do you think it's okay 
for me to enter...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her unusually timid question brings a wry 
smile to my face. It seems she's still 
deeply bothered by that time she tried to 
force her way into racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, as mentioned before, her 
recovery is progressing well. Having been 
bedridden for a while, she had to start by 
rebuilding her muscle strength, but—"
choice_data_list:
At this rate, we'll make it in time. You 
worked really hard.

At this rate, we'll make it in time. You 
worked really hard.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thank goodness...!! Thank you so 
much...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank you... truly, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having finished the last item on 
today's menu... a light run, K.S. Miracle 
turned toward me on the hill.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"……Once again, please let me apologize, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry about what happened back at the 
Sprinters Stakes. ...And for everything 
after that, too."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I've caused you so, so much trouble... I'm 
so sorry.
choice_data_list:
It's no trouble at all. ...Though I was 
worried about you.

It's no trouble at all. ...Though I was 
worried about you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I was panicking all by myself the whole 
time. ...I was scared.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ending things without being able to do 
anything... Leaving without being able to 
give everyone a single thing... I just 
can't—
choice_data_list: ...Even if I can't win a GⅠ,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words spilled out softly. ...Born from 
an honest heart, they flowed from my lips 
far more easily than expected.
choice_data_list: Even if it had just ended like that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Supposing that without ever conquering 
the Sprinters Stakes, and without claiming 
a single GⅠ victory, she ends her racing 
career just like that."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Umamusume world, new stars are born 
one after another. It is certainly true 
that one can easily end up hidden behind 
their brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, their existence... will likely 
be forgotten. Only a tiny handful leave 
their names in history. Most Umamusume 
simply fade beyond memory's reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—For many people, that was probably the 
case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How encouraged we were by your earnest 
running. The joy of seeing you in high 
spirits in the paddock. The days we shared 
our excitement and deep emotions together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That they loved that speed. That miracle. 
That legend. That they loved K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Someone, somewhere, will always 
remember.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like the people who became her fans. Like 
the people who supported and stood by her. 
Like—myself, captivated by the way she 
ran.
choice_data_list:
And they surely must have passed down the 
tale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: KS Miracle, and no one else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That she was the absolute finest, most 
glorious horse girl—one who would continue 
to shine brilliantly within her own 
memories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just receiving those memories, those 
treasures, was honestly more than enough. 
It was never true that nothing remained, 
or that nothing was given.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just the fact that she started running. 
Just the sight of her energetically 
dashing across the turf... that alone is 
truly more than enough.
choice_data_list:
You might not be satisfied with just that, 
but...

You might feel like that's not enough, 
though.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gaze at K.S. Miracle, who has fallen 
silent, ever so kind and stubborn. A smile 
escapes me. And so, I continue.
choice_data_list:
...So, if it's okay for me to wish for 
even more,

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
choice_data_list:
I want you to stay healthy for as long as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because if I'm going to tell the tale, I 
want to tell as much as possible. I'd like 
to pass down a whole mountain of stories 
if I can."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't have to be a glorious record. 
It's fine if you show a pathetic run 
sometimes. It's fine if there are 
embarrassing troubles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even if you choose never to return to the 
turf someday. Even if you never step into 
the public eye again, that's completely 
okay."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, there is so much, so much proof 
that a girl named K.S.Miracle ran, and 
lived on――"
choice_data_list: Nothing is worth more than that.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange, isn't it? I can't help 
wondering why.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Why... is everyone so kind to me?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still... precisely because they're all 
like that, as expected—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ……The wind is getting colder, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for staying so late. Let's head 
home. I need to get to bed early, and then 
give it my all tomorrow too.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything heading into the 
race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the day of the Swan Stakes 
safely arrived."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mi-ra-cle~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
There you areee!! For real, you're here! 
So that means you're running, right!? We 
get to race together, don't we!?!?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Helios... yeah. As you can see, I'm 
completely fine now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO, I'm so glad, pal---!! Seeing you 
all better... seriously, it means the 
world...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you as well, Bamboo... No matter how 
many times I thank you two and Zephyr, it 
would never be enough.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: And also—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I look forward to working with you 
today.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Ruby. Yeah, let's do this.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can stand right here is all 
thanks to you. I really, truly—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: That'll do.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: It's in the past now. ...More importantly.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Focus on the contest before you. If your 
mind is wandering, then—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will surge ahead and win at the wire.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Gratitude is one thing, but 
that's another matter.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I won't lose. Helios, Bamboo...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And also, Ruby. To you as well, 
absolutely."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let us go.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Um, thank you very much... for 
inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's coming out now...! ...Thank 
goodness. Her complexion looks good. What 
a relief, truly...!
choice_data_list:
...I'm so sorry. I've caused you so much 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't apologize so many times. 
That child... opened her eyes once more. 
It's all thanks to everyone around her, 
and to you.

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
And today, you will also show us your 
energetic, spirited running. ...That is 
the understanding, correct?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing me, K.S.Miracle offers a somewhat 
awkward bow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was the sentiment behind those gestures an 
apology, a surge of resolve, or something 
else entirely?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race to achieve her revival begins 
now.
